paper_title: 2-Tier SimCSE Elevating BERT for Robust Sentence Embeddings
caption: : Figure 2: Accuracy comparison of different models on paraphrase sentiment, and STS tasks.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates a comparison of accuracy scores across several models for paraphrase sentiment and STS (Semantic Textual Similarity) tasks. The horizontal axis lists model configurations including “Single-task_baseline,” “Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout,” “Unsupervised_SimCSE,” “Supervised_SimCSE,” and “2-Tier SimCSE,” and is ordered from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy / Correlation,” ranges from 0 to approximately 0.8, utilizing a linear scale with tick intervals of 0.1. The bars, colored in pastel pink and light blue, represent the respective accuracy scores for each model configuration. The bar labeled “Single-task_baseline” is approximately 0.52, while the tallest bar, “2-Tier SimCSE,” reaches a value of approximately 0.78.  The “Sentiment Acc. Corr.” bar is consistently shorter than the “Paraphrase Acc. Corr.” bar, with a value of approximately 0.60 versus 0.70, respectively.  All bars are uniformly colored and appear to be sorted in order, with the model “2-Tier SimCSE” exhibiting the highest average accuracy score relative to the other listed model configurations.
